title: Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Tenders
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 390 F. Beat the egg in a shallow bowl. In a second bowl mix panko, Parmesan, garlic powder, paprika and Italian seasoning.
Pat chicken dry, dip in egg and press into the crumb mixture. Discard leftover raw-chicken coating mixtures.
Arrange in a single layer, lightly brush with oil and air fry for about 9-12 minutes, turning halfway. Work in batches if necessary.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Serve with separately prepared broccoli, sweet potato or dipping sauce if desired; the listed time covers the chicken only.

title: Honey Dijon Chicken
ingredients: 1 large raw boneless skinless chicken breast
instructions: Slice chicken into even cutlets. Mix honey, mustard, garlic, lemon juice and paprika.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add chicken and cook about 4-6 minutes per side.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Lower the heat and add the mustard mixture with 2 tablespoons of water. Simmer for 2 minutes, coating the chicken. Serve with separately prepared vegetables if desired.

title: Sweet and Spicy Chicken Thighs
ingredients: 3 medium raw boneless skinless chicken thighs
instructions: Mix honey, soy sauce, hot sauce, oil, garlic and paprika. Coat chicken in the mixture and marinate in the refrigerator for 10 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 380 F. Arrange chicken in one layer and air fry for about 14-18 minutes, turning halfway. Discard used marinade.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Rest for 3 minutes before slicing. Sweet potatoes or Brussels sprouts are separate optional sides. Total time includes the short marinade.

title: Buffalo Chicken Wraps
instructions: Pat the chicken dry. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the tenders for roughly 4-6 minutes per side, depending on thickness.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Mix yogurt, buffalo sauce and garlic powder. Slice the cooked chicken.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan. Divide lettuce, pickles, chicken and sauce between them; fold and serve. Sweet potato sides from your notes are separate recipes.

title: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Tenders, unbreaded version
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 380 F. Pat chicken dry and toss with oil, garlic powder, Italian seasoning and paprika.
Arrange in a single layer. Air fry for about 10-14 minutes, turning halfway.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Sprinkle Parmesan over the hot chicken and let stand for 2 minutes before serving. This version has no breading.

title: Pesto Pasta with Grilled Chicken
ingredients: 1 large raw boneless skinless chicken breast
instructions: Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook pasta according to its package. Reserve 1/2 cup cooking water before draining.
Slice chicken into thin cutlets, coat with oil and cook in a hot grill pan for about 4-6 minutes per side.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Halve tomatoes. Toss drained pasta with pesto, tomatoes and a splash of pasta water; add sliced chicken and Parmesan.

title: Pepperoncini Chicken Salad
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups chopped cooked chicken breast, chilled
instructions: Shred or dice the cooked, chilled chicken. Use safely stored cooked chicken; this timing does not include cooking raw chicken.
Stir together yogurt, pepperoncini, onion, dill and brine.
Fold in chicken. Serve over washed salad greens. Keep chilled until serving.

title: Creamy High Protein Chicken Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 1 large raw boneless skinless chicken breast
instructions: Cook macaroni according to its package. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water and drain.
Dice chicken. Heat oil in a skillet and cook the pieces over medium heat for about 7-10 minutes, turning regularly.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Blend cottage cheese, milk and garlic powder until smooth. Warm gently in the pasta pot over low heat, then stir in cheddar until melted.
Fold in macaroni and chicken; loosen with pasta water as needed. Do not boil the sauce. The title is retained from your notes; no nutritional analysis has been verified.

title: Gochujang Sesame Chicken Noodle Bowls
ingredients: 1 large raw boneless skinless chicken breast
instructions: Cook noodles according to their package, then drain. Mix gochujang, soy sauce, honey, sesame oil and 2 tablespoons water.
Dice chicken and slice the pepper. Heat neutral oil in a large skillet and cook chicken for about 7-10 minutes.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Add pepper, cabbage, garlic and ginger; stir-fry for 3-4 minutes. Add sauce and noodles, toss until hot and finish with sesame seeds.

title: Chicken Avocado Crunch Salad
ingredients: 1 3/4 cups chopped cooked chicken breast, chilled
instructions: Wash and chop romaine and cucumber. Slice the avocado and cooked chicken.
Whisk olive oil with lemon juice in a large bowl.
Toss lettuce, cucumber and carrots with the dressing. Add chicken, avocado and pumpkin seeds. Total time assumes chicken is already cooked.

title: Chicken Caprese Bowls
ingredients: 1 large raw boneless skinless chicken breast
instructions: Combine rice and water in a saucepan. Bring to a simmer, cover and cook according to the rice package; let stand covered for 5 minutes.
Cut chicken into thin cutlets. Heat oil in a skillet and cook for about 4-6 minutes per side.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Halve the tomatoes and slice mozzarella. Divide rice and chicken into bowls and top with tomatoes, mozzarella, basil and balsamic glaze.

title: Pesto Chicken Burrata Sourdough Toast
instructions: Toast the sourdough. Slice the cooked chicken and halve the tomatoes.
Spread pesto on the toast. Add chicken, torn burrata and tomatoes, then drizzle with oil.
Serve promptly. This 15-minute version uses ready-cooked chicken.

title: Honey Garlic or Sweet Heat Chicken with Rice
ingredients: 1 large raw boneless skinless chicken breast
instructions: Cook rice with the water according to its package. Mix honey, soy sauce, garlic, vinegar and chili flakes for a sweet-heat honey-garlic sauce.
Dice chicken. Heat oil in a skillet and cook the pieces over medium heat for about 7-10 minutes, turning regularly.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Lower the heat, pour in the sauce and simmer for 2 minutes. Divide chicken and sauce over rice. This combines the two flavor alternatives in your title into one newly drafted version.

title: Chicken Broccoli and Ziti
ingredients: 1 large raw boneless skinless chicken breast
instructions: Boil ziti according to its package; add broccoli during the last 3 minutes. Reserve 1/2 cup cooking water and drain.
Dice chicken. Heat oil in a large skillet and cook for about 7-10 minutes.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Add garlic and stir for 30 seconds. Fold in pasta, broccoli, Parmesan and lemon juice with enough pasta water to lightly coat.

title: Pepperoncini Chicken
ingredients: 1 large raw boneless skinless chicken breast
instructions: Cut chicken into thin cutlets. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook for about 4-6 minutes per side.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Add garlic and Italian seasoning; stir for 30 seconds. Add pepperoncini, brine and broth.
Simmer gently for 3-4 minutes, turning chicken in the sauce. Serve with a separate side if desired.

title: Sesame Ginger Stir Fry Chicken
ingredients: 1 large raw boneless skinless chicken breast
instructions: Slice chicken and pepper. Mix soy sauce, vinegar, honey, ginger, garlic, sesame oil and 2 tablespoons water.
Heat neutral oil in a large skillet. Cook chicken for about 7-10 minutes, turning often.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Add broccoli, pepper and 2 tablespoons water. Cover for 3 minutes, then uncover and stir-fry until tender-crisp. Pour in sauce, heat through and finish with sesame seeds.

title: Spicy Butternut Squash Pasta with Chicken
ingredients: 1 large raw boneless skinless chicken breast
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 F. Toss squash and garlic with half the oil and roast on a sheet pan for 25-30 minutes until tender.
Cook rigatoni according to its package and reserve 1/2 cup pasta water. Meanwhile dice chicken and saute in remaining oil for about 7-10 minutes.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Let squash cool briefly. Blend with broth, Parmesan and chili flakes; follow your blender instructions for warm liquids and do not seal hot liquid in a personal blender.
Toss sauce, chicken and pasta together over low heat, adding pasta water as needed. Top with burrata. This version omits sage, matching your later notes.

title: Creamy Spicy Mini Meatball Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 of a 1-pound package raw ground beef
instructions: Shape beef into about 12 small meatballs. Heat oil in a skillet and brown meatballs on all sides, about 8-10 minutes.
Add onion and cook for 4 minutes; stir in garlic, tomato paste and chili paste for 1 minute.
Add broth and simmer covered for about 8-10 minutes. Check meatballs with a thermometer: ground beef must reach 160 F (71 C).
Cook spaghetti separately according to its package, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water.
Lower the sauce heat and stir in cream and Parmesan. Toss with spaghetti and enough pasta water to coat.

title: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Sausage Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 fully cooked Italian chicken sausage links
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to its package and reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
Slice the fully cooked sausage. Heat oil in a skillet and cook sausage and shallot for 5 minutes; add garlic and chili flakes for 30 seconds.
Add broth and simmer for 3 minutes. Follow the sausage package heating directions.
Remove from heat. Temper yogurt with a spoonful of warm broth, then stir it into the pan with Parmesan. Toss in spaghetti, loosening with pasta water. Do not boil the yogurt sauce.

title: Creamy Tomato Garlic Chicken Angel Hair
ingredients: 1 large raw boneless skinless chicken breast
1/3 of a 1-pound package dry angel hair pasta
instructions: Dice chicken. Heat oil in a skillet and cook over medium heat for about 7-10 minutes.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Transfer chicken to a clean plate. Add butter and shallot to the pan for 3 minutes, then garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add halved tomatoes and broth; simmer for 6-8 minutes. Cook angel hair separately according to its package, reserving a little pasta water.
Lower the sauce heat and add cream, Parmesan and chicken. Toss with drained pasta, loosening with pasta water if needed.

title: Creamy Spicy Tomato Chicken Sausage Orzo
instructions: Slice sausage and brown in oil in a deep skillet for 3-4 minutes. Add garlic, chili and orzo; stir for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and broth. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook, stirring frequently, for about 10-12 minutes or until orzo is tender; add more water if needed.
Follow the fully cooked sausage package heating directions. Stir in spinach until wilted.
Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan. Let stand for 2 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Pepperoncini Chicken Sausage Pasta
instructions: Cook penne according to its package, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
Brown sliced sausage in oil in a skillet for 4 minutes. Add garlic for 30 seconds, then pepperoncini, brine and broth; simmer for 3 minutes.
Follow the fully cooked sausage package heating directions. Lower the heat and stir in cream and Parmesan.
Toss in pasta and enough reserved water to make a creamy sauce.

title: Burrata Chicken Pasta
ingredients: 1 large raw boneless skinless chicken breast
instructions: Cook pasta according to its package and reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Dice chicken. Heat half the oil in a skillet and cook for about 7-10 minutes.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Set chicken on a clean plate. Add remaining oil, halved tomatoes and garlic to the skillet; cook for 5-7 minutes until tomatoes soften.
Toss pasta and chicken with the tomatoes and a splash of pasta water. Top with torn burrata and basil.

title: Homemade Hamburger Helper
ingredients: 1/2 of a 1-pound package raw ground beef
instructions: Brown beef and onion in a deep skillet over medium heat, breaking up clumps. Drain excess fat.
Stir in tomato paste, paprika and garlic powder. Add macaroni, broth and milk; bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and cook for about 10-12 minutes, stirring frequently and adding water if needed until pasta is tender. Check the beef mixture reaches 160 F (71 C).
Remove from heat and stir in cheddar until melted. Rest for 2 minutes to thicken.

title: High Protein Mac and Cheese with Chicken
ingredients: 1 large raw boneless skinless chicken breast
instructions: Cook macaroni according to its package, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
Dice chicken and saute in oil over medium heat for about 7-10 minutes.
Check the thickest part of the chicken with a food thermometer: it must reach 165 F (74 C). Timing varies with thickness and appliance.
Warm milk gently in the pasta pot and stir in cheddar and mustard over low heat. Remove from heat and stir in yogurt.

Fold in chicken and macaroni, loosening with pasta water. This yogurt version is kept separate from the cottage-cheese variation in entry 8; the inherited high-protein title is not a verified nutrition claim.

title: Spicy Calabrian Chili Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta according to its package and reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Warm oil in a skillet over medium-low heat. Stir garlic for 30 seconds, then tomato paste and chili paste for 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 8-10 minutes. Toss with drained pasta and enough pasta water to coat.
Remove from heat and add Parmesan and basil.

title: Ground Beef Taco Bowls
ingredients: 1/2 of a 1-pound package raw ground beef
instructions: Cook rice with water according to its package.
Brown beef in a skillet, breaking it into small pieces. Stir in taco seasoning and 2 tablespoons water and simmer for 3 minutes.
Check ground beef reaches 160 F (71 C) with a food thermometer.
Divide rice and beef into bowls. Add sliced avocado, tomatoes, washed lettuce, cheese and salsa.

title: Loaded Taco Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: 1/2 of a 1-pound package raw ground beef
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 F. Scrub and halve sweet potatoes lengthwise, brush cut sides with oil and place cut side down on a sheet pan. Roast for 35-45 minutes until fork-tender.
Meanwhile brown beef in a skillet. Add taco seasoning and 2 tablespoons water; simmer for 3 minutes. Ground beef must reach 160 F (71 C).
Fluff sweet potato centers with a fork. Divide beef and cheddar over them and return to the oven for 2 minutes to melt cheese.
Top with avocado, salsa and yogurt.

title: Steak Rice Bowls
ingredients: 1 medium raw steak, about 1 inch thick
instructions: Cook rice with the water according to its package. Slice cucumber and avocado.
Pat steak dry, rub with half the oil and garlic powder and sear in a hot skillet, turning as needed. Cooking time depends on thickness.
Use a thermometer to check steak reaches 145 F (63 C), then rest for at least 3 minutes before slicing.
Mix remaining oil with lime juice. Divide rice, sliced steak, cucumber, avocado and pickled onions into bowls; drizzle with dressing.

title: Bean and Cheese Burritos
instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat and soften the onion for 4-5 minutes.
Stir in refried beans and salsa; heat through, stirring frequently.
Divide the filling and cheese between tortillas. Fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Place seam-side down in a dry skillet and toast for 2-3 minutes per side until the cheese melts.

title: Healthy Banana Pancakes
instructions: Mash the banana in a bowl. Stir in the egg, oats and cinnamon; let stand for 3 minutes. No baking powder is needed.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat and add the oil. Spoon in small pancakes, about 2 tablespoons each.
Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until set throughout with no wet egg batter in the center. Lower the heat if the banana browns too quickly.
Serve immediately. This oat version is a newly drafted version of your original banana-pancake notes.

title: Banana Coconut Chia Pudding
ingredients: 1 Medjool date, pitted and finely chopped
instructions: Mash half the banana in a jar. Stir in coconut milk, chia seeds, chopped date and vanilla.
Wait 10 minutes, then stir again to break up clumps. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours until thick.
Stir in the Greek yogurt. Add a splash of coconut milk if too thick and top with the remaining sliced banana just before serving.
The estimated total includes 4 hours of chilling; hands-on preparation is about 10 minutes.

title: Banana Bread Chia Pudding
instructions: Mash the banana in a jar and stir in milk, chia seeds, oats, cinnamon and vanilla.
Let stand for 10 minutes and stir again. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours until the chia seeds have thickened.
Top with walnuts before serving. This banana-bread-flavored version is newly drafted because the preferred original variation was not recovered.
The estimated total includes chilling time.

title: Greek Yogurt Bowls with Fruit and Granola
instructions: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Wash the berries and arrange them over the yogurt with the sliced banana.
Top with granola and honey just before eating so the granola stays crisp.

title: Eggs, Sausage, Cheese and Avocado Bagels
instructions: Slice the sausage and warm it in a skillet according to the package directions. Set aside.
Melt butter in the skillet. Beat the eggs and scramble over medium-low heat until fully set; egg dishes should reach 160 F (71 C).
Toast the split bagel. Place cheese on the warm eggs so it softens.
Layer eggs, sausage and sliced avocado onto the bagel and serve.

title: Cottage Cheese Fruit Bowls
instructions: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Wash berries and drain pineapple if canned; arrange the fruit over the cottage cheese.
Add walnuts and drizzle with honey.

title: Turkey Avocado Bagel Sandwich
instructions: Toast the split bagel. Mash the avocado and spread it on one half; spread mustard on the other.
Layer turkey, washed lettuce and tomato onto the bagel. Close and serve.

title: Healthy Banana Sweet Treats
instructions: Slice the banana into thick coins. Line a small freezer-safe tray with parchment.
Mix yogurt with peanut butter and spoon a little onto each banana slice. Sprinkle with chocolate chips.
Freeze for about 2 hours until firm, then transfer to a freezer container. Let stand a few minutes before eating.
This is a newly drafted frozen-banana snack variation; the original entry had only a title. Total time includes freezing.

title: Roasted Sweet Potato Halves
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 F. Scrub sweet potatoes and cut in half lengthwise.
Rub cut sides with olive oil and garlic salt. Place cut side down on a lined sheet pan.
Roast for 35-45 minutes until a fork slides easily into the thickest part. Let cool for 3 minutes before serving.

title: Air Fryer Sweet Potato Cubes
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 390 F. Scrub potatoes and cut into even 3/4-inch cubes; dry well.
Toss with oil and seasonings. Arrange in one layer, working in batches if necessary.
Air fry for about 15-20 minutes, shaking halfway, until tender inside and browned outside.

title: Homemade Pico de Gallo
instructions: Wash the produce. Dice tomatoes and onion finely. Remove jalapeno seeds if you prefer less heat and finely mince it.
Mix tomatoes, onion, jalapeno, cilantro, lime juice and salt.
Let stand for 5 minutes, stir again and serve. Refrigerate until needed.

title: Healthy Chicken Dipping Sauce
instructions: Stir yogurt, mustard, honey, lemon juice, garlic powder and paprika together in a small bowl.
Add a teaspoon of water if you want a thinner sauce. Keep refrigerated until serving with cooked chicken.

title: Crispy Roasted Brussels Sprouts
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 F. Trim Brussels sprouts, halve lengthwise and dry thoroughly.
Toss with oil, salt and pepper. Spread cut side down on a sheet pan with space between pieces.
Roast for 25-30 minutes until deeply browned and tender. Turn large pieces if needed.

title: Garlic Roasted Broccoli
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 F. Wash and dry broccoli thoroughly, then cut into evenly sized florets.
Toss with oil and salt and spread on a sheet pan. Roast for 12 minutes.
Toss with garlic and roast for 5-8 more minutes until tender and browned. Finish with lemon juice.

title: Roasted Butternut Squash
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 F. Cut squash into evenly sized 3/4-inch cubes.
Toss with oil, salt, pepper and thyme. Spread on a lined sheet pan in a single layer.
Roast for 25-35 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned.

title: Honey Dijon Dressing
instructions: Whisk Dijon, honey and vinegar in a small bowl.
Slowly whisk in olive oil, then water and pepper. Stir well before serving and keep refrigerated.

title: Creamy Pepperoncini Yogurt Dressing
instructions: Chop pepperoncini finely and stir into yogurt with brine, oil, lemon juice, dill and garlic powder.
Let stand for 5 minutes. Thin with a teaspoon of water if needed and refrigerate until serving.

title: Homemade Sweet and Spicy Chicken Sauce
instructions: Combine honey, soy sauce, hot sauce, vinegar, garlic and water in a small saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer over medium-low heat, stirring frequently, and cook for 3-4 minutes until lightly syrupy.
Use as a finishing sauce for already cooked chicken; do not use sauce that has touched raw chicken without cooking it thoroughly.
